summary:
No new work claimed; the run is within about two minutes of expiry and there is no open gap or tractable lead left for that window. The path returned is the last accepted draft, unchanged, which the contract records as no_change rather than a duplicate revision — I am not manufacturing a marginal item to fill the remaining interval.

The record is complete as delivered: eleven investigations, all locally answered or explicitly bounded; three receipt-backed defects (unbound leadership-transfer acceptance, the constant-zero configuration index defeating the documented `prevIndex` guard, and repeated identical automatic snapshots on a snapshot-recovered idle node with a control); one conditional finding (deprecated voter-only peer encoding on a below-protocol-2 leader after a rollback-style restart); and sourced behaviours with stated limits covering snapshot recency, lease-bounded verification, reload validation, configuration propagation, pipeline cursors, the heartbeat fast path, and the log-store, barrier, progress, shutdown, observation, batching, RPC-version and existing-state contracts. The two unresolved boundaries remain flagged in place rather than smoothed over. No further action from me; the run may expire on this record.
